name: Custom Status Report
description: Allows the customization of the core Status Report page.
project_description:
By default the Status Report page (/admin/reports/status) doesn't allow any customization, but sometimes you just want to show some more information here. This module allows the customization of the Status Report page: hide information you don't need, or add status cards from other modules to keep track of statuses all in one place.

Features

Hide any of the default cards from the General System Information section.
Add a custom card from your own module (or any other module that supports this) to the General System Information section to display other relevant statuses.

Post-Installation
Once installed there will be a configuration page at admin/config/system/custom-status-report that will allow you to show or hide any available cards, and drag to reorder them.
